alt: Six questions a reader might ask at the end, each matched to a conclusion strategy: why it matters (significance), what to do (a call to act or solution), what follows (implications), how it relates to the start (return to the introduction), what to remember (a compelling image), and pull it together (a summary in new words).
caption: If a reader could still ask “So what?”, the conclusion has not done its job.

alt: Five small diagrams of conclusion shapes: returning to the introduction (an arrow loops back to the opening), widening the lens (a cone from a point outward), narrowing to action (a funnel to an arrow), looking forward (a line continuing as a dashed arrow) and a closing image (a framed picture).
caption: Return, widen, narrow to action, look forward, or close on an image.

after: ## Weak and strong conclusions side by side
alt: The weak conclusion (“In conclusion, there are many reasons... Thank you for reading”) sits above the strong one, split into four parts: a return to the bus driver image that reframes the cause, a brief concession of cost, the benefit drawn together, and a final link to the purpose of schooling.
caption: The thesis is plainly present without being repeated word for word.

after: ## Worked example 1: writing a conclusion that fits its purpose
alt: An essay map: the introduction’s empty platform, three body paragraphs (fewer car journeys, custom for shops, a safe route) and a conclusion that gathers them, returns to the platform, states the significance and calls on the council to approve the funding.
caption: Unity, significance and a call to act chosen for a council deciding on funding.

after: ## Worked example 2: describing the function of a published conclusion
alt: The closing sentence of the Gettysburg Address set out as three rising clauses: that the dead shall not have died in vain (a call to act), that the nation shall have a new birth of freedom (an aim), and that government of, by and for the people shall not perish (a widened lens and a compelling image). The triple phrase is highlighted.
caption: One resolution in three parts turns mourning into a shared task.
